title: Add F# semantic implementations
outcome: Ship Phoenix v0.12.87 F# position-only semantic implementations using compiler-proven FCS entity, dispatch-slot, and typed object-expression relations across one pinned workspace snapshot, the selected closure, declaring project, and proven dependents; globally deduplicate declarations, disclose filters and incomplete coverage, preserve the C# implementations envelope/ranking rules, use operation-neutral fsharp_workspace_* partial reasons, keep implementations on a separate AssemblyContents checker cache, and leave IndexBuilder.SchemaVersion at 31.
acceptance: Abstract, virtual, and interface member positions return exact overrides by ImplementedAbstractSignatures; a position on an override or explicit implementation retargets to all implemented slots and discloses resolvedFromOverride.

AssemblyContents traversal finds object expressions through every supported FSharpExpr child form, excludes quotation bodies with explicit coverage disclosure, and returns objectExpression symbols shaped as base/interface display name, kind objectExpression, path, and full range.

BuildInfo.Version is 0.12.87, fsharp-implementations-workspace has its own features[] entry, unsupported-language boundary text drops implementations, all owned docs and capability pins are updated, full gates and same-session dual review pass, and no push occurs.

Focused tests cover cross-project interfaces, generic/entity-kind relations, overload-exact overrides and override retargeting, nested object expressions, declaring-project parity, TFM dedupe, filters, deterministic deadline salvage, discovery/binary/unsupported boundaries, contract parity, response budgets, and an external F# MCP implementations assertion.
Implementations use a separate keepAssemblyContents=true checker cache so symbol_at/references caches remain untouched; no new limits are introduced and the existing request deadline bounds cost.

Interface implementations and derived types are compiler-bound by FCS entity identity, generic instantiations match their generic type definition, and implementing entities may be classes, structs, records, unions, exceptions, or derived interfaces.

One pinned snapshot and shared capture session scan the selected F# closure, distinct declaring project, and proven workspace dependents with global physical declaration dedupe across contexts and TFMs; filters apply before totals and are explicitly disclosed.

Seven operation-neutral fsharp_workspace_* coverage tokens replace the v0.12.86 fsharp_references_* tokens without aliases, classifiers stay exact-preserving, and a distinct fsharp-workspace-coverage-tokens features[] entry documents the rename.

The closed implementationKind set is interfaceImplementation, derivedType, override, and objectExpression; abstract entities rank abstract, concrete entities and object expressions rank concrete, abstract scaffolding is included like C#, and concreteCount/likelyImplementation exactly follow the C# complete-and-untruncated rules.

The existing implementations tool remains backward-compatible for C#; F# is position-only and rejects incompatible selectors including positive maxProjects, while C# rejects F#-only arguments instead of ignoring them.

workspaceComplete is true only for complete discovery and scans; incomplete, failed, binary-changed, unsupported, deadline, or pending work returns an exact lower bound with totalIsLowerBound and byte-budgeted coverage detail.

completion.summary: Delivered and committed PhoenixCodeNav v0.12.87 compiler-semantic F# implementations across supported workspace closures with honest coverage, filters, cancellation salvage, verified dependent binaries, response budgeting, capability/version/docs updates, external integration coverage, and decisive regressions. Commit a3afcb2b6ab5709c2781df4bd69f4b851a59a121 contains exactly the 16 cleared owned paths; no push.
